QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Francis in Danger
QuestInfo.0: Francis is calling you. Answer Francis's phone call.
QuestInfo.1: It sounds like Francis is in danger somewhere in the old main hall of Shinsoo International School. Hurry up and go help him.
QuestInfo.2: Looks like Francis escaped safely. However, you should keep an eye on the old main hall of Shinsoo International School. Something's not right about that place.
